name: code-guide
description: Turn a pull request, or a question about how code works, into a zoomable canvas of the files involved, with callouts, a merged diff, and every line checked against git.

interface.shortDescription: Zoomable maps of PRs and code
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex for a guide to a pull request, or to how part of a codebase works, and get an interactive, canvas-style map of your code that zooms from folders down to individual lines. It shows every file involved and how they connect, with callouts beside the lines that matter, a merged diff in PR mode, and a guided tour. The model writes a JSON spec; a fixed build script checks every referenced line against git and fails on any line it can't find.
defaultPrompt: Make a code guide for PR #482
Show me how the checkout flow works as a code guide
